query: SELECT i.run_id, i.product_id, i.settled_at, r.source, COALESCE(p.title, '') AS "title!" FROM import_run_item i JOIN import_run r ON r.org_id = i.org_id AND r.id = i.run_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.org_id = i.org_id AND p.id = i.product_id WHERE i.org_id = $1 AND i.state = 'imported' AND i.settled_at IS NOT NULL AND i.product_id IS NOT NULL AND r.source IS NOT NULL AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR i.settled_at < $2) ORDER BY i.settled_at DESC LIMIT $3
